about: A written verdict for every planted bug (mutant) that survived the newest mutation run of study/check_study.py (validation/mutation-runs/). Matched by function, line, column and the change. A web test fails if a survivor has no entry here or an entry matches no survivor.

entries.why: Stops creating missing parent folders for checks.json. The parent folder (data/) always exists by then, because run() has already read data/frame/sample.csv inside it.
Indents checks.json by two spaces instead of one. Every value in the file stays the same.
Cuts one more character off the start of each search result line. The checks count result lines and never read their text, and a line is still counted when it ends up empty.
Shows one more letter of a long school name in the checker's printout. checks.json and every pass or fail stay the same.
